scenes.vo_segment: What happens if you take five dollars every single day and simply never spend it?
scenes.visual_description: Character holding a crisp $5 bill with question marks popping around head. Background splits into calendar pages rapidly flying off.

scenes.vo_segment: Tuck it under your mattress, and in thirty years, you'll have fifty-four thousand dollars.
scenes.visual_description: Cut to bedroom. Character slides stack of cash under a mattress. Calendar clock fast-forwards 30 years (hair turns slightly grey). A giant vault counter rolls up to $54,000.

scenes.vo_segment: Sounds decent, right? Wrong. Inflation quietly eats half of that buying power.
scenes.visual_description: Giant red 'WRONG' stamp slams across screen. A cartoon inflation monster (or Pac-Man style chomper labeled 'INFLATION') bites the stack of cash in half.

scenes.vo_segment: But put that exact same five dollars a day into the S&P 500, and compound interest turns it into over three hundred and thirty thousand dollars.
scenes.visual_description: Screen wipes with green grid. S&P 500 rocket/exponential curve shoots upward. Split screen comparison: tiny $54K cash pile vs towering $330K+ gold vault.
Clean, bold call-to-action screen. Minimalist modern typography with an animated pulsing start button and compounding spark icon.
